headline: 3 Reasons WYNN is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Over the past six months, Wynn Resorts’s shares (currently trading at $95.86) have posted a disappointing 16% loss, well below the S&P 500’s 7.9% gain. This might have investors contemplating their next move.
